scope: True world-position retail pickup placement for amboy, gracia and river. Each pickup is reconstructed on its committed retail .aid racing line from the decoded route, arc and lateral, then tested against the measured e1-drive band. A pickup inside the band is placed at its retail world position; every other pickup stays off-course with its exact distance. There is no arc-fraction remap.
retailWorldRule: routePoint = interpolate(route.points, retail.arc); tangent = normalize(routePoint[i+1] - routePoint[i-1]); normal = (tangent.z, -tangent.x) (.aid frame normal = (fz, -fx)); lateralOffset = retail.lateral - retail.width * racingOffsets[retail.segment]; candidate = routePoint + normal * lateralOffset. The .aid normal sign relative to the stored point order is authored per route, so the candidate (normal or -normal) that reproduces the committed retail WorldMatrix.aw position is kept and normalSign records which one was used. aidResidualM is the planar distance between the kept candidate and that committed position; it is a decode check, not a position source.
bandRule: nearest = clamped segment projection of the retail world position onto the measured course polyline (ties keep the earlier segment); inside = nearest.distance <= band.halfWidthMetres. The band is course.band.halfWidthMetres when present, otherwise course.corridor.halfWidthMetres. It is a declared controller/respawn band, not a road-width claim.
placeableRule: A pickup inside the band is placed at its retail world x/z; y is the groundY of the nearest measured sample; arc/measuredArc is the exact interpolated measured arc of the projection; retailArc is the retail .aid arc; lateral is the decoded retail lateral; residualM is the centreline distance; physicalProjection is true.
offCourseRule: A pickup outside the band is not moved. It is recorded with its retail world x/z, the exact distanceToCourseM to the measured centreline, distanceToBandM (distance beyond the band edge), nearestMeasuredArc and the reason string. No coordinate is invented and no pickup is dropped silently.
